parameters.name: AnomalyId
parameters.description: The ID of the alert event. You can call [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) to obtain the alert event ID. The value is in the data.SuspEvents[index].UniqueInfo path.

parameters.name: AnomalyUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the asset associated with the alert event. You can call [DescribeSuspEvents](~~DescribeSuspEvents~~) to obtain the asset UUID. The value is in the data.SuspEvents[index].Uuid path.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace of the graph. Set this parameter to hundun_dc_online.

parameters.name: VertexId
parameters.description: The vertex ID. You do not need to specify this parameter.
